name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Browse terminals, agents and workspace activity.
description: Publishes the live sidebar as one tree: workspaces and their worktrees, tabs, and the panes in each tab, plus terminals in no tab; every level can be hidden. Its options are in the Show popup and in Settings. It can show a resource in a tab or explicitly kill a terminal program. Turn it off to lose live sidebar content and its controls; saved layouts and backend-owned programs remain.

needs.why: Show opens a terminal or agent in a tab

works_with.without: Terminals are listed without workspace and worktree groups
No Agent settings action on agent rows
No Stop agent action on agent rows
No Forget agent action on unavailable agent rows
Agents without a terminal status sequence (Claude Code hooks) show no state
Close ended items only hides them
